prompt: A system administrator wants to review the legacy single-file PAM configuration that applies only when the per-service files in `/etc/pam.d/` are absent. Which file is that?
explanation: `/etc/pam.conf` is the legacy global PAM configuration file. It is used only when `/etc/pam.d/` does not exist; when the `/etc/pam.d/` directory is present it takes precedence and `/etc/pam.conf` is ignored.
